Bloomberg.t: Japan’s Top Insurers Revive Lending as Rates Boost Returns
Bloomberg.s: Japan’s biggest life insurers are stepping up lending, with a focus on overseas projects including data centers, as higher interest rates make loans more attractive and surging investment in artificial intelligence and power networks fuels demand for capital.

Bloomberg.t: China’s Oil Majors Get More Firepower for Energy Security Push
Bloomberg.s: Improved profits at China’s state-owned oil majors are likely to help them deliver on Beijing’s demands for energy security.

Bloomberg.t: Treasuries Extend Rally With Global Peers as Risk-Off Haven
Bloomberg.s: A rally in Treasuries gathered pace in Asia on Friday as a selloff in US tech stocks drove investors to the safety of US government debt.

Bloomberg.t: Kioxia Faces Test to Impress With Earnings After 60% Stock Slump
Bloomberg.s: Kioxia Holdings Corp. needs to clear a high bar with its upcoming results, after its swift slump from the world’s top stock gainer to the worst performer in the battered memory chip sector.

Bloomberg.t: Dollar’s Rate-Fueled Rally Seen Surviving US Midterm Gridlock
Bloomberg.s: The dollar’s rally may have enough momentum to shrug off the US midterm election, with high interest rates and a surge in AI-related spending drawing capital even if the vote delivers political gridlock.

Bloomberg.t: Chinese Investors Seek Shelter in Long-Bond ETFs as Stocks Sink
Bloomberg.s: Chinese investors are piling into exchange-traded funds tracking longer-dated government bonds, seeking shelter in a rallying debt market while local stocks keep sliding.

Bloomberg.t: Codelco Dismisses Eight Staff as Copper Output Scandal Widens
Bloomberg.s: Chilean copper giant Codelco let go eight employees after investigations into irregularities in the recording and reporting of production in 2024 and 2025 uncovered new evidence.

Bloomberg.t: Stock Selloff Deepens on Tech Earnings, Bonds Rise: Markets Wrap
Bloomberg.tt: Asya Hisse Senetleri Baskı Altında, Liman Teklifi Tahvilleri Artırdı: Piyasalar İyileşiyor
Bloomberg.s: Technology shares led a global stock selloff as another round of disappointing earnings accelerated a rotation out of the artificial intelligence trade and drove investors toward haven assets such as Treasuries. Crude oil rallied.
Bloomberg.ss: Asya'daki hisse senetleri, ABD teknoloji devlerindeki satış dalgasının yatırımcıları hisse senedi piyasasının diğer bölümlerine yöneltmesi ve tahvil talebini artırmasının ardından düşüşe geçti.

Bloomberg.s: Oil surged on signs the US may resume military strikes against Iran, risking fresh turbulence in the region that may hurt energy flows.

Bloomberg.t: Binance Suspends Withdrawals After Suspected Hack
Bloomberg.s: Binance suspended all deposits and withdrawals as it investigates a security incident that has resulted in the freezing of more than $2.5 billion in assets. Bloomberg's Suvashree Ghosh breaks down the news. (Source: Bloomberg)

CNBC.t: People in China are spending nearly as much of their income as Americans on healthcare
